name: Word of Light Healing, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 6, inquisitor 5, shaman 5, witch 6
Target one living creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart.

This spell functions like word of light healing except that it heals 1d4 + 1 per two caster levels to all creatures (maximum +12).
